title: Post-Reasoning: Improving the Performance of Non-Thinking Models at No Cost
abstract: arXiv:2605.06165v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: As the widespread adoption of Large Language Models (LLMs) accelerates, token consumption from intermediate reasoning traces increasingly contributes to inference latency and operational cost. Recent studies suggest that many real-world tasks require little to no explicit reasoning, with additional reasoning sometimes even degrading performance. In this work, we propose Post-Reasoning, a simple yet effective approach that improves instruction-tuned models by conditioning them to justify their answers after generating the final response. By design, it enables the final answer to be obtained without additional latency or token cost, while still improving performance through simple instruction augmentation. We evaluate Post-Reasoning across 117 model--benchmark settings spanning 13 open and proprietary models, 4 model families, and 9 diverse reasoning and knowledge-intensive benchmarks, including AMC, HMMT, GSM8K, GPQA, MMLU-Pro, and BI

translated_title: 后推理：零成本提升非思考型模型的性能
translated_abstract: 随着大语言模型（LLM）的广泛应用不断加速，来自中间推理链的token消耗日益成为推理延迟和运营成本的重要来源。近期研究表明，许多现实世界的任务几乎不需要显式推理，额外的推理有时甚至会降低性能。在这项工作中，我们提出了“后推理”，这是一种简单而有效的方法，通过让指令微调模型在生成最终回答之后对答案进行论证，从而提升模型性能。从设计上看，该方法使最终答案能够在不产生额外延迟或token成本的情况下直接获取，同时仍可通过简单的指令增强来提升性能。我们在117个模型-基准设置上对“后推理”进行了评估，涵盖13个开源和专有模型、4个模型家族，以及9个多样化的推理和知识密集型基准测试，包括AMC、HMMT、GSM8K、GPQA、MMLU-Pro和BI。
tldr: “后推理”让指令微调模型在生成最终答案后再进行答案论证，从而在不增加任何推理延迟或token成本的情况下有效提升模型性能。
en_tdlr: Post-Reasoning improves instruction-tuned models by having them justify their answers after generating the final response, delivering performance gains at no additional latency or token cost.
